items.title: Check-in and check-out
items.body: Check-in after 3:00 pm, check-out by 11:00 am. If you need a different time, let us know in advance and we'll find a solution.

items.title: Quiet hours
items.body: Please keep noise down between 10:00 pm and 8:00 am — out of respect for the neighbours and the calm of the place.

items.title: Pool
items.body: Use of the pool is at your own risk. Children must be supervised by an adult at all times.

items.title: Smoking
items.body: Smoking is allowed only on the open terraces. The villa interior is non-smoking.

items.title: Pets
items.body: Pets are welcome only by prior arrangement with us.

items.title: Caring for the villa
items.body: Please treat the space as your own home. Part of the deposit is withheld in case of damage.
